course_name_original: Choix des Matériaux – Durabilité et environnement

learning_outcomes.text: Know the main characteristics of different classes of materials, especially those involved in the aerospace industry and energy production. Awareness of the energy and societal challenges in these sectors.

syllabus_topics: Materials durability under specific conditions (mechanical loadings, corrosion, ageing…)
Materials selection: improved knowledge of properties inherited from manufacturing routes
Life cycle and environmental concerns in the energy and transportation industries
bibliography: Matériaux: ingénierie, science, procédé et conception, Presses polytechniques et universitaires romandes 2013, Michael F. Ashby, Hugh Shercliff, David Cebon
Choix des matériaux en conception mécanique, Dunod 2012, Michael F. Ashby
institution: ISAE-ENSMA (École nationale supérieure de mécanique et d'aérotechnique)
